name: BACH_0180
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (61%)** · Ambiguous: Invasive vs InSitu · Careful review
Simulated frozen section cannot exclude InSitu (37%) [F1]; superior, medial, lateral margins positive [F8].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 61%, InSitu 37% | Invasive leads; InSitu plausible |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (alpha 10%) | Both classes remain plausible |
| Reliability / OOD | 97% reliability; 64th percentile [F6] | Typical image; unflagged |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Agree on top | Backbones match top call |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive [F5]; InSitu 84% | Neighbors match; contrast close |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 6, 10) · ↑ invasive · +1.27 contribution favors stromal invasion [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 0, 2, 4) · ↑ invasive · +0.64 contribution; prominent nuclear atypia [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · +0.47 contribution from scarce tubules [F4] · Weak
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · +0.31 contribution from low confinement · Weak
- **Nuclear size** (regions 2, 4, 8) · context · Mean 82 µm², 95th percentile [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful; deleting top-3 risk regions drops P(invasive) above random (CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unproven (CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0); necrosis (3/20), mitoses (0/20), normal_lobules (0/20) Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- High-grade InSitu (37%; 84% BACH_0117 similarity) mimics invasion via pleomorphism without stromal breach.
- Frozen-section artifacts distort borders or margins (stains blocked; inferior margin nears threshold).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 2, 4**: Verify stromal invasion versus InSitu in top-risk regions.
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Compare duct confinement and tubules against InSitu contrast BACH_0117.
3. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 11**: Check superior (215 µm), medial/lateral (108 µm), inferior margins.
